alt.en: White panel-door kitchen cabinets with built-in oven, hob, hood, sink and light grey laminate floor

caption.tr: Beyaz boyalı, çerçeveli kapaklı mutfak dolapları. Üst dolaplarda camlı iki kapak, alt tarafta çekmeceler ve ankastre fırın yer alıyor.
caption.en: Kitchen cabinets with white painted framed doors. Two glazed doors sit in the upper row, with drawers and a built-in oven below.
